items.title: We’ve Been Giving AI Agents Access Wrong.
items.summary: This video is sponsored by Teleport. Learn more about Teleport’s Agentic Identity Framework: https://fandf.co/4hyPyfG AI agents can now read your tickets, query your databases and change your infrastructure on their own, and most of them do it with a shared password. In this video I look at why agents need their own identity, then run the same task twice on a test store. With one shared admin login, the agent deleted more than a million audit-log rows, and the database log could not say who did it. With every agent getting its own identity through Teleport, the same model was refused and asked a human instead. items.title: Is AI Holding Kids Back from Learning? (Ep. 1036 with Jon Krohn)
items.summary: In Episode #1036, Jon Krohn digs into the question parents and teachers keep asking: does AI stop children from learning? Drawing on a wave of new studies, he shows the answer turns entirely on how AI is used, as a shortcut that outsources the thinking, or as a tutor that explains and gives feedback. Along the way: a 30,000-student natural experiment in China, a striking tutoring result from Turkey, and three practical takeaways that apply just as much to adults using AI at work. Additional materials: https://www.superdatascience.com/1036

items.title: Ostara Advisors CEO Says EV Startups Are Ready For Post-Subsidy Era
items.summary: In June 2025, India achieved a landmark milestone by reaching 50% non-fossil installed power capacity, more than five years ahead of its Paris Agreement commitment. However, as federal schemes like PM E-DRIVE and FAME adjust and global EV policies shift, the climate tech ecosystem must transition from subsidy reliance toward sustainable total cost of ownership (TCO) parity, private risk capital, and catalytic development financing. In this episode of Front Page, Sudhi Sachdev sits down with Vasudha Madhavan, Founder & CEO of Ostara Advisors, India’s first dedicated climate tech investment bank. They explore the evolution of climate tech M&A since 2015 (including Greaves Electric Mobility’s acquisition of Ampere Vehicles), the transition of electric two- and three-wheelers into post-subsidy profitability, unlocking patient international capital, balancing AI data center power demand against industrial decarbonization, and scaling biogas and clean deep-tech infrastructure across the Global South.
